skala_old_engine #

ReSharper other — Revert to old formatting engine ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified Tier C — accepted and deliberately ignored. ⚠ Observable, and that is what makes Tier C the honest label rather than a hidden inert claim: at true the oracle produces different bytes on a wrapped fixture, because it reverts to ReSharper's previous formatting engine. Skala has no previous engine to revert to. An oracle glob would report INERT for a difference nobody intends to close.
